text: In Philadelphia, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe is [shot in his own home|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] by a former patient he failed to help. The next fall, estranged from his wife Anna, he takes on Cole Sear, a frightened nine-year-old who confides that he [sees dead people|rules|only some can see it]. When Malcolm hears a hidden voice on an old session tape, he believes the boy and urges him to learn what [the ghosts need from him|wants|release and unfinished business]. A videotape lets a dead girl named Kyra [reveal how she died|ending|the hidden truth comes out].
